'''Walking Cow Heads''' are the [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Cow|Assimilated Cows]].

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Cow dies.
*Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Cow Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units. 
* Walking Cow Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Cow Heads can perform small leaps.
* They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Cow.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Cow Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Walking Cow Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Cow Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Cow Heads will run away during the daytime if no other Parasites are present.
